newsitem.title: USA: Series of modest earthquakes shake Los Angeles.
newsitem.headline: Series of modest earthquakes shake Los Angeles.

text.p: A series of moderate earthquakes shook the Los Angeles area early Sunday, the second time in two days residents have been awaken by a rolling motion.

A spokesman for the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) said the first temblor, which struck at 4:09 a.m., had a magnitude of 4.9 on the Richter scale. A series of smaller earthquakes followed.
The earthquake was the second in two days. On Saturday, a 5.0 earthquake struck at 3:37 a.m.

Caltech said both quakes were aftershocks to the 1994 Northridge earthquake, which had a 6.8-magnitude, killed more than 50 people and caused billions of dollars in damage throughout the Los Angeles area.
